The evidence explicitly states that the standard LIC algorithm (Cabral and Leedom) computes a separate field line segment and convolution integral for each pixel. It contrasts this with the optimized algorithm (Stalling and Hege), which avoids redundancies by computing long field line segments and updating the convolution integrals incrementally for pixels covered by that same segment.
